scripts.build: echo 'Building .NET microservices...' && echo 'This project uses Docker Compose for building.' && echo 'Run: docker-compose -f src/docker-compose.yml build'
scripts.setup: echo 'Setting up .NET microservices project...' && echo 'This project requires Docker and .NET 8 SDK.' && echo 'Please run setup.ps1 for complete setup on Windows.'
scripts.info: echo 'This is a .NET 8 microservices project with:' && echo '- Catalog API (Product management)' && echo '- Basket API (Shopping cart)' && echo '- Discount gRPC (Discount service)' && echo '- Ordering API (Order management)' && echo '- YARP Gateway (API Gateway)' && echo '- Shopping Web (Frontend)' && echo '- PostgreSQL, Redis, SQL Server, RabbitMQ'
scripts.docker:up: cd src && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up
scripts.docker:build: cd src && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml build
scripts.docker:down: cd src && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml down
